run_get_safety_checker: run get_safety_checker to instantiate a list of safety checker objects based on enabled options
run_auditnlg_sensitive_topics: run AuditNLGSensitiveTopics to check output text for sensitive topics using the auditnlg library
run_salesforce_safety_checker: run SalesforceSafetyChecker to classify text as safe or unsafe using the Salesforce Flan T5 model
run_azure_safety_checker: run AzureSaftyChecker to analyze text for violence, self-harm, sexual, and hate content via Azure API
run_llamaguard_safety_checker: run LlamaGuardSafetyChecker to evaluate user or agent prompts for safety using the Llama Guard 3 model
